'''DS-61-4''' is a Star Wars CCG writing handle on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]]. The DS II & Beyond index credited that handle for EPP & ECC Beatdown.<ref name="or">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/14lite.htm EPP & ECC Beatdown], The Outer Rim (DS-61-4). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20091027155333/http://geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/14lite.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
